verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a split-inbox or focused-streams feature that separates important, team, newsletter and calendar-invite mail for priority-ordered triage. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: team inboxes and shared spaces for collaboration, generic automation rules and labels, snoozing, and an external agent triaging against a CRM via MCP.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
